articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on SWE-Bench and near-human performance on graduate-level STEM visual reasoning tasks, marking a significant step toward unified AI systems.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Long-Context Scientific Literature Synthesis
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Ultra 2 with a 4-million-token effective context window and demonstrated its ability to synthesize findings across hundreds of research papers with verifiable citations. The model introduces a novel hierarchical attention mechanism that reduces memory overhead quadratically, making ultra-long-context inference practical on standard TPU v6 pods.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots have entered limited production deployment at the Fremont and Austin gigafactories, performing complex multi-step assembly tasks including wire harness routing and quality inspection. The Gen 3 units feature upgraded 27-DOF hands and a new onboard vision-language model that allows real-time task adaptation without reprogramming.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Toyota Research Institute Unveil General-Purpose Manipulation Framework for Atlas
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics and TRI jointly announced a foundation model-driven manipulation framework for the electric Atlas robot that enables it to learn new manipulation tasks from fewer than 10 demonstrations. The system combines diffusion policy architectures with real-time sim-to-real transfer, achieving 94% success rates on previously unseen household and industrial tasks in independent testing.

articles.title: Anthropic Publishes Breakthrough Research on Mechanistic Interpretability of Frontier Model Planning
articles.summary: Anthropic released a landmark paper demonstrating the ability to trace multi-step planning and deceptive reasoning circuits in large language models at the individual neuron cluster level. The work introduces 'causal circuit graphs' that allow researchers to verify whether a model's internal reasoning aligns with its stated chain-of-thought, directly advancing AI safety evaluation methodologies.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node with Backside Power Delivery
articles.summary: TSMC announced volume production of its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node at its Fab 20 facility in Tainan, featuring second-generation backside power delivery network technology. The node delivers approximately 25% performance improvement or 35% power reduction over N2, positioning it for next-generation AI accelerator and mobile SoC designs shipping in 2027.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Correction Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum reported achieving below-threshold error rates on logical qubit operations using their combined hardware-software stack, executing over 100,000 consecutive logical CNOT gates with error rates under 10⁻⁸. This milestone significantly narrows the gap toward commercially viable quantum error correction and practical quantum advantage for materials simulation workloads.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Production for Warehouse Logistics
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C at an $18 billion valuation, with funding led by Bezos Expeditions and Microsoft, to scale production of its Figure 03 humanoid robot for deployment across BMW and Amazon warehouse operations. The Figure 03 integrates an on-device multimodal model co-developed with OpenAI that enables natural language task instruction and autonomous error recovery in unstructured environments.
